★★★★★ 3 days ago Best coffee in Seminyak, hands down. The cold brew was smooth and the staff remembered my name on day two. Will be back every morning of my trip.
★★★★☆ a week ago Great flat white and the avocado toast is generous. Lost a star because the queue at 8am was out the door — get there early or after 10.
★★★★★ 2 weeks ago Worth the hype. Magic coffee (Australia-style) was excellent, beans sold by the bag. Outdoor seating only — bring a fan.
★★★★☆ 3 weeks ago Kopi susu mereka enak, porsi croissant besar. Tempat duduk terbatas, jadi datang sebelum jam 8 kalau mau duduk di dalam.
★★★★★ a month ago As a Swede who takes coffee seriously: this is the only place in Seminyak that pulled a Cortado correctly. Brunch plate was generous too.
★★★☆☆ a month ago Coffee was good but the music was too loud for a morning chat. Maybe acceptable for digital nomads with headphones.
★★★★☆ 2 months ago Solid espresso, friendly baristas. Cash only some days so bring rupiah just in case. Vibe is hipster-minimalist.
